description: The linear futures contracts (perpetual and dated) a futures venue lists now, as an array of contract symbols: the `symbol` values blackforge_futures_latest and blackforge_futures_series accept. Contracts are spelled the way each venue spells them: binance, bybit and bitget `BTCUSDT`, okx `BTC-USDT-SWAP`, gate and mexc `BTC_USDT`, kucoin `XBTUSDTM`, dated contracts such as `BTCUSDT_261225`. The futures venues and the plan each needs are under `futures.venues` in blackforge_catalog; a venue outside the key's plan is an HTTP 403 carrying the plan and an upgrade URL. Not metered.

exchange.description: Futures venue from blackforge_catalog `futures.venues`, e.g. binance, okx, bybit.
